release_notes: Health Connect: now reads real active-calorie and distance records from your watch/health app (when it writes them) instead of estimating everything from step count alone — numbers should now line up with what that app itself shows.

Fix: Health Connect sync previously only ever ran via the manual "Sync Now" button or reopening the app from the background — a real bug meant a true cold start silently skipped syncing every time. Now fixed.

New: a "Not seeing your data? Diagnose" screen in Profile checks whether Health Connect is installed, whether each permission is granted, and whether it actually has any recent data — the fastest way to find out why something isn't syncing.

New: Progress has an Exercise Details card — today's steps, distance, and active calories from Health Connect, plus an hourly step chart. A pencil icon at the top of Progress lets you drag its cards into whatever order you prefer.
New: a sync (↻) button on Home, next to the notification bell, next to the existing one in Profile.
New: if you've barely touched your Cheat Day's bonus calories, Home offers to move it to the next day instead of losing it.
New: tap a logged Fitness entry to edit it (category, intensity, duration, distance, calories) instead of deleting and re-logging.
New: Food and Fitness both show a hint that entries can be tapped to edit or swiped left to remove.
